title: Chapter 400 The Power Of Magic
content:
Chapter 400 The Power Of Magic

The Yaozu is the Yaozu. Compared with the weak human race in frontal hand-to-hand combat, even if these human races are warriors with strong martial arts cultivation, they are still much stronger.

Although their strength had been damaged a lot just now, with their bloody courage and desperate and fierce fighting style, they really broke through this line of defense and rushed in front of the fighters on the third floor.

In fact, for Zhong Yu's empire, the third-tier ordinary soldiers are nothing at all. He has conquered more than a hundred worlds, even though many of them are very small in scale compared to the world of Liao Zhai, but some third-tier soldiers have appeared in the field. Practitioners can still do it.

Under the support of so many worlds, training the strong with all one's heart and soul, and not wasting resources to go to other places, the card effect that can be caused is not ordinary powerful.

Up to now, the total number of Tier 3 powerhouses controlled by Zhong Yu has exceeded one million, which is equivalent to the scale of Tier 3 masters in the entire Ming Dynasty.

Therefore, the death of some ordinary Tier 3 fighters is nothing to Zhong Yu's empire, just a drop in the bucket.

Just like those spearmen with swords, shields and spears just now, in Zhong Yu's eyes, they are just cannon fodder for consumption, and it is not worth any pity at all. As long as the goal can be achieved, no matter how many deaths are worth it.

What he really valued were those mystic masters who had practiced mystic arts.

Practicing profound arts is not that simple, without certain aptitude, how can one be a fellow practitioner of martial arts.

Some aptitudes may not be able to succeed, and you need to have a sufficient foundation of understanding and a certain opportunity to achieve a certain level of achievement.

After so many rounds of screening, the mysterious master who can finally become a talent can be said to be one in a million, which is very precious.

Among the millions of third-tier legions, there are only 50,000 members of the Mystic Master cultivation system, and these 50,000 people have basically exhausted their potential, and they will not be able to make any breakthroughs in this life.

But by virtue of their profound skills, they can achieve the strength of one against ten in the same level.

Even because of the characteristics of fellow practitioners of law and martial arts, they are able to display more exquisite and ingenious formations. Only three or five people are needed to form a formation, and some fourth-level strengths with relatively shallow foundations are enough to attract Zhong Yu's attention.

As for the Tier 4 masters in the Zhong Yu Empire, those who reached Tier 4 in ordinary cultivation systems were directly assigned to various legions by him as high-ranking generals.

Those mystic masters who are unsurpassed in geniuses and whose owners have the world's potential are cultivated by Zhong Yu, and countless resources are invested, and finally such an army of fourth-order mystic masters with a scale of ten thousand people is created.

As for reaching the fifth level, for Zhong Yu's current empire, it is also an extremely important high-end combat power. Either as the commander of a large army, or as the lord of a world, his status is extremely respected.

After the Yaozu broke through the line of defense, they arrived at the third line of defense, which was formed by a formation of 3000 fighters.

Although these fighters are not as powerful as those mystic masters, they are still quite powerful among the same level. With their own superb skills, they can still fight one against two or three, and even the best of them fight against one Enemy five or enemy ten is fine, almost no weaker than a mystic master.

It's just that the number of people is too small, and there is not much training value.

These monsters broke through the second line of defense, and before they had time to cheer happily, they were stunned by the fighters of the third line of defense.

The same powerful strength, but with more exquisite skills, but in a few moves, he took away the life of a demon with the same rank.

These monsters had only been in contact with the fighters for a moment, and they were killed by more than a thousand people abruptly, directly defeating the entire formation of the monster clan.

As for the surviving monsters, after repeated damages, the total number is not enough to add up to a thousand people. Under the package strangling of the surrounding army, they were all wiped out after a while.

In this way, an army of 5,000 monsters attacked the Royal Army of about 10,000 people, and the battle was resolved in just one hour.

As a result, the demon army was completely annihilated, and the imperial army only sacrificed more than 2,000 people and won a complete victory.

This kind of battle damage ratio is very impressive, at least compared to the situation of the entire continent.

For the countries on the mainland, when their standing armies meet the large-scale army of the monster race, they usually end the battle with a one-to-one loss ratio, or even a little bit more crippled, and the human race will have to sacrifice even more.

After all, in frontal hand-to-hand combat, the monster race has too many advantages over the human race by virtue of its size advantage, strong defense, and its own racial talent, so it naturally has the upper hand in fights.

The only thing the human race can rely on is their own more subtle formations and powerful spells.

It's just that there are too few people who cast spells, and they are often controlled by various sects. These sects don't listen to the announcement, and they only acknowledge the dynasty's right to rule over them in name, but in fact they don't make a fuss at all.

And the dynasty has nothing to do with them. If they forcefully exterminate them, it is likely to cause hostility from the entire cultivation world. In the end, no matter how powerful the dynasty is, they will definitely be unable to resist and can only be destroyed.

Therefore, the troops that the major dynasties can use are often warriors. There are not many noble spellcasters at all, and they are all cultivated by some dynasties since childhood.

But they are not as powerful as the carefully trained disciples of the major sects, and their strength is not very strong, and their scale is not very large.

However, there are no exceptions. For example, the Great Qin Empire mentioned earlier can be powerful.

All kinds of geniuses emerged in the imperial court one after another, and one after another was powerful and unrivaled, and each one was the best of the same rank, a figure who could dominate.

It was as if the geniuses of the entire Qin Empire had opened a bug, and their strength soared upwards, and within a few years they could achieve the cultivation effect of others for decades.

Coupled with its own unique farming and warfare system, there are many more low-level powerhouses. In the end, the power of the entire empire was gathered, and it actually overwhelmed the power of the cultivation world of the entire empire, occupying an absolute advantage.

In this way, the Great Qin Empire with enough power can order the entire domestic cultivation world to order each sect to send out their elite children to serve in the army.

And under the tough attitude of the empire, if the sect disobeyed even a little, it would be encircled and suppressed by the army, and the sect would be wiped out.

It can be said that the sects in the territory of the Great Qin Empire live the most miserable life in the cultivation world, which is called a miserable one.

However, it was precisely because of the joining of these sects that the military strength of the Qin Empire became stronger and stronger. This was the record of Qin's 30,000 frontier army defeating more than 200,000 demon army.

In addition to the strong strength of the Qin army itself, coupled with the high-level generals, a considerable part of the reason is that the disciples of these sects joined and used powerful magic power to carry out large-scale long-range strikes on the monster army. .

However, perverts are always rare, and other dynasties are still normal dynasties.

Facing the attack of the Yaozu's legion, they usually use several times the number of people to resist, and forcefully rely on crowd tactics to submerge them.

After all, whoever made the major dynasties have so many people, so tens of thousands of dead, and hundreds of thousands of troops would not feel bad.

This also shows from the side that in war, when there is no qualitative change, quantity is still a key advantage.
